name: email-sequence-superengine
description: Voice-matched broadcast email sequences for high-ticket coaches. Run setup once, then generate any of 8 campaigns: pre-call show-up, pre-sell VSL script, launch, warm nurture, no-show recovery, post-call follow-up, win-back, and new-client onboarding. Broadcast model (built once, fires to everyone) with a dosed storytelling engine, pitch-floor controls, a voice-edge dial, teach-mode explanations, and ESP-agnostic output plus optional GoHighLevel push. Drafts only, never sends. Your stories and config persist across plugin updates.
